Apple___Apple_scab.description: Apple scab is a common fungal disease that affects apple trees, causing lesions on leaves and fruit.
symptoms: Olive-green to black scabs on leaves

Apple___Black_rot.description: Black rot is a fungal disease that affects the fruit, leaves, and bark of apple trees.
management: Prune out dead or diseased wood

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.description: A fungal disease that requires both apple and cedar trees to complete its life cycle.

Apple___healthy.description: The plant is healthy with no visible signs of disease.
management: Plant appears healthy. Maintain regular watering and fertilization.

management: Apply foliar fungicides early in the season

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.description: A bacterial disease favored by warm, humid weather.
symptoms: Small, water-soaked, greasy spots on leaves
Spots turn dark with yellow halos

Tomato___Early_blight.description: Fungal disease causing spotting on older leaves.
symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings (target pattern) on lower leaves

Tomato___Late_blight.description: Rapidly spreading and highly destructive disease.
symptoms: Large, dark, water-soaked lesions on leaves
Firm, dark brown rot on fruit

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.description: Primarily a greenhouse problem driven by high humidity.
symptoms: Pale green or yellow spots on upper leaf surface
Olive-green to brown mold on lower surface

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.description: A destructive disease of tomato foliage.
symptoms: Numerous small, circular spots with dark borders and gray centers
management: Mulch base to prevent soil splash

Tomato___Spider_mites_Two-spotted_spider.description: Tiny pests that suck sap from the plant.
symptoms: Stippling or yellow speckling on leaves
Fine webbing on undersides of leaves
management: Spray with water to dislodge mites
Apply insecticidal soap or neem oil

Tomato___Target_Spot.description: Fungal disease affecting all above-ground plant parts.
symptoms: Small necrotic lesions with light brown centers

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.description: A viral disease transmitted by whiteflies.

symptoms: Mottled light and dark green leaves
management: Do not use tobacco around plants
